topic: The Nature of the Five Senses is Knowledge

source.book: An Intimate Note to the Sincere Seeker — Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar
source.chapter: The Nature of the Five Senses is Knowledge

slides.text: Did you know every cell in your body can see, hear and feel?
Not just your eyes or ears. Every single cell carries that same *potential*.
That's why people who lose one sense say the others grow sharper.
You don't have to lose a sense to sharpen it
slides.cta: Just sit in silence, and notice what's already there.
